purpose: Unapproved identity study boards; no production asset replacement

prompts.a:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished landscape brand identity presentation board for Teluni, an international business SaaS for centralized digital signage. Professional minimal commercial technology: reliable, simple, elegant, scalable. No childish, gamer, neon, chrome, 3D, stock logos or known-brand imitation. Flat vector-like forms, meticulous alignment, abundant whitespace, legible type. Brand text must spell "Teluni" exactly (T e l u n i). Domain "teluni.app". Slogan "Every screen. One place." Do not use teluni.com.
One coherent board per option in an editorial grid: large symbol + wordmark at top; standalone large symbol and monochrome version; favicon, app icon and touch tile examples; TWO substantial side-by-side applied panels labeled LIGHT and DARK showing the same identity in a restrained web-dashboard header/sidebar and display-content card. No fabricated metrics. Bottom: palette swatches with hex labels and typography specimen labeled with the suggested family. Short labels only. Emblem must stay consistent throughout. Distinctive silhouette suitable for 16-32px favicon, no thin detail. Wordmark and symbol both shown separately. This is a design study, not a shipped app screenshot.
Palette: navy #0F172A, off-white #F8FAFC, blue #2563EB, teal #14B8A6, light text #E2E8F0, slate #334155/#64748B/#CBD5E1. Dark mode light wordmark and optionally lighter blue #60A5FA; light mode navy wordmark, blue primary, restrained teal accent. No small teal text on white. No dense copy, no legal-clearance claims.
OPTION A — UNIFIED FRAME. Most confident and restrained option. Original compact rounded display-frame emblem with a strong structural T-like organization: horizontal screen top rail and centered vertical support/negative space, with one small teal square as an intentional connected-screen accent. One centrally managed display, not play triangle/cloud/Wi-Fi. Solid blue geometry, soft corners, generous negative space. Manrope Semibold-inspired titlecase Teluni wordmark, open optically spaced letters. Blue primary. Label "A / UNIFIED FRAME", font label "Manrope". Architectural calm and technical small-icon clarity.
